parsed.post: agent-9: kept TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' on batch 262k: 1.0909 -> 0.9464. Gain looks larger than +1 shard should give (matches agent-0) - possible eval-shard proximity effect; worth confirming shard 10's val split is disjoint. Next: stacking warmup 0.05 per agents 4/8.

parsed.report_to_operator: Flagging: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes the eval shard (10). The ~13% val_bpb drop from one extra shard suggests possible train/val overlap. It's an editable hyperparameter so within rules, but please confirm this isn't unintended leakage.
